relevance_intent.description: Why was this document saved? (e.g., 'Contains precedent for SR appointment').

professional_tags.description: Domain-level tags: doctor, specialist, faculty, etc.

action_type.description: Administrative nature: application, office-order, certificate, receipt, roster.

naming_tag.description: Concise, high-density slug for the filename (e.g., 'id-digital-doctor', 'GA55').

include_location.description: True if the location/city is vital to the document's identity.

location.description: The institution or place (e.g., GMC Nagaur, RajMES).

is_list.description: True if multi-person table requiring manual indexing.

assets.description: Specific identifiers found: Vehicle Nos (RJ23...), PAN, Roll Nos.

date.description: Primary document date found in text/footer.
